Event_Title: US expands advanced semiconductor export controls
Event_Description: BIS announced updated export controls on advanced computing semiconductors and semiconductor manufacturing items, including expanded restrictions affecting exports to China and other destinations. The controls created regulatory and market-access risks for NVIDIA's affected products.

NVIDIA unveiled its Blackwell GPU architecture and computing platform, designed for advanced AI training and inference. The announcement included new GPU technologies and partnerships with major cloud providers and technology companies.

Event_Title: NVIDIA reports record Q1 FY2025 revenue
Event_Description: NVIDIA reported quarterly revenue of $26.0 billion for Q1 FY2025, up 262% year over year. Data Center revenue reached $22.6 billion, up 427% year over year, reflecting strong demand for AI computing infrastructure.

Event_Title: US imposes H20 chip export licensing requirement
Event_Description: NVIDIA disclosed that the US government informed it on 9 April 2025 that exports of its H20 integrated circuits to China, Hong Kong, Macau and certain other destinations would require a licence. The company was informed on 14 April that the requirement would remain in effect indefinitely.

Event_Title: NVIDIA reports Q1 FY2026 results and H20-related charge
Event_Description: NVIDIA reported revenue of $44.1 billion, up 69% year over year. The company also recorded a $4.5 billion charge related to H20 excess inventory and purchase obligations following US export licensing requirements.

Event_Title: DeepSeek-R1 release triggers concerns about AI infrastructure demand
Event_Description: DeepSeek released its R1 reasoning model, drawing attention to the potential of lower-cost AI development. On 27 January 2025, investors reassessed expectations for AI infrastructure demand, and NVIDIA shares fell nearly 17% amid a broader technology-sector selloff. The market reaction should not be interpreted as proof that the model alone caused the share-price decline.
Evidence_Status: Confirmed – Product release and reported market reaction

Event_Title: NVIDIA joins the Dow Jones Industrial Average
Event_Description: NVIDIA replaced Intel in the Dow Jones Industrial Average, with the change taking effect before market trading on 8 November 2024. S&P Dow Jones Indices stated that the change would provide more representative exposure to the semiconductor industry.

Event_Title: NVIDIA reports record fourth-quarter and FY2025 revenue
Event_Description: NVIDIA reported Q4 FY2025 revenue of $39.3 billion, up 78% year over year. Full-year FY2025 revenue reached $130.5 billion, up 114%, while quarterly Data Center revenue reached a record $35.6 billion.

Event_Title: NVIDIA announces Blackwell Ultra AI platform
Event_Description: NVIDIA unveiled Blackwell Ultra, the next evolution of its Blackwell AI computing platform. The platform was designed to support more demanding AI training, reasoning and inference workloads, including agentic AI applications.

Event_Title: US announces non-enforcement and planned recission of AI Diffusion Rule
Event_Description: The US Department of Commerce announced that it would rescind the AI Diffusion Rule and instructed enforcement officials not to enforce it. The announcement also included additional measures to strengthen certain semiconductor export controls. The policy change created a potentially different regulatory environment for global AI chip distribution.
